text.occurrence_observations: Twelve distinct supplied entries are visible once, no additional print seen.
issues: Spaces around date and hour en-dashes differ from required literal spacing.

style.checked_requirement: Deep ultramarine, warm vermilion and pale ochre form a deliberate gouache painting. Broad matte pigment planes, dry-brush edges inside substantial forms and controlled light/shadow make the caring gesture readable. A large contrast-stroke Korean Title feels painted in rhythm but remains clearly typeset; the body and small information use calm regular sans anatomy, never brush-corrupted glyphs. Paint one observable caring action: a mature hand grips a watering vessel and a short stream lands at the exposed soil, beside upward branching houseplant leaves. Warm hand planes and the red vessel cross the cool blue plant shadows. Use weight-bearing contact, credible wrist and grip, a consistent pouring direction and a stable pot opening, with no cute characters or toy rendering.

observations.observation: Ultramarine and warm vermilion/ochre combine in broad matte painted planes with visible dry brush; Title has contrast-stroke anatomy. Some distant plant masses are softly blurred.

ratio.observation: One edge is within the predeclared half-pixel native rounding allowance; no resize performed.

observations.observation: Large adult forearm grips red watering-can handle; water lands in visible pot soil beside connected upward stems, with pot resting on painted surface.

hangul.observations: Title syllables have open counters and contrast strokes; body and practical words have stable sans anatomy and meaningful word spaces. No missing Hangul syllables observed.

information_relationship.observations: Title → companion → Subtitle → three-line paragraph → date/hours/place → access/care → invitation/URL follows a single left axis with functional gaps. Small practical type weakens ease of use.

function_contact.observations: Forearm cropped at upper edge connects to wrist and closed grip; fingers wrap a handle. Downward water trajectory visibly meets exposed soil. Pot base meets a surface and a dark painted shadow.

material_edge.observations: Warm hand planes, brush ridges on can and terracotta pot, articulated leaf veins and blue shadows form a coherent painting; no floating pot or pasted asset edge seen.

template_exclusion.observations: The large care action from upper crop through pot and soil visually organizes the right half and painted surface. The left serif Title and readable information are coupled to a substantive painted gardening scene; imagery is not a tiny subordinate decoration.

located_observations.observation: Large pale Title and red watering gesture are two immediate anchors; upright plant and tabletop complete an active scene.
Stable left starts connect prose and visiting details, but small explanation/footer needs a larger optical body.
